items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I know he had a brother named Give-a-Damm Jones

ctx.x: Maybe so. Maybe so. But I know he had a brother named Give-a-Damm Jones, you know, and he was -- yeah, he was -- I don't know. The cop told him something, and he told him he didn't give a damn. I don't know what it was, but that's the story about Give-a-Damn. But anyhow, now we're going from the De Luxe, aren't we?
Yes. You haven't described the De Luxe. You said there was a billiard parlor downstairs.
